account.withdrawBody: Stop us using your data for matching, alerts and sharing, without deleting your account. You stay signed up and can come back whenever you like. This is a pause, not an erasure: to have your data removed, delete your account below.
account.withdrawHolders: Withdrawing takes back {applications, plural, =0 {no applications} one {# application} other {# applications}} and {interests, plural, =0 {no course interests} one {# course interest} other {# course interests}}. Those employers and training providers stop seeing your name and contact details.

account.withdrawEffectApply: You cannot apply or register interest until you confirm the notice again.
account.withdrawEffectTrack: Nothing is tracked and no push notifications are sent.
account.withdrawEffectStill: You can still sign in, download your data, correct your profile, delete your account, and come back.
account.withdrawError: Your consent could not be withdrawn. Nothing was changed. Try again.
